features.name: DX Cluster
features.notes: Direct Telnet connection; no proxy required. Core spot display equivalent to original.

features.name: Moon Phase & Position
features.notes: Moon phase, rise/set, azimuth/elevation equivalent.

features.name: SDO Solar Images
features.notes: Direct SDO image fetch; selectable wavelengths.

features.name: Weather (DE/DX)
features.notes: Uses open-meteo.com directly.

features.name: Gimbal/Rotator Control
features.notes: Upover mode confirmed implemented in RotatorService.cpp (el>90° az+180 flip). flipActive_ flag drives UPOVER indicator in GimbalPanel. cfg_->rotatorUpover persisted in config. set_rotator REST endpoint added (commit 5d5bd6ce). All original features present.

features.name: Satellite Tracker
features.notes: libpredict v2, TLE management, satellite track on map. Reviewed 2026-03-02: SatPanel and SatelliteManager implement equivalent functionality. No get_satellite.txt or set_satname REST endpoints.

features.name: ADIF Log Viewer
features.notes: List with band/mode filter; QSO pins on map. Reviewed 2026-03-02: functional equivalent.

features.name: Santa Tracker
features.notes: Seasonal Dec 24/25.

features.name: EME Planning Tool
features.notes: Full 2-day moon elevation chart (48h), time axis, Next Up table showing next simultaneous above-horizon window, 30s micro-stepping for precision rise/set. Implemented 2026-03-02 (WI-7).

features.name: Stopwatch / Count-up
features.notes: Lap recording fully implemented in StopwatchPanel.cpp. laps_ vector stores cumulative elapsed durations. Lap button active while running. Lap table shows up to 5 entries with L## total + split format. Current lap counter shown below main time. set_stopwatch REST endpoint added (commit 5d5bd6ce).

features.name: Solar Flux / Kp / SSN History
features.notes: SFI, Kp, SSN plots via HistoryPanel.

features.name: Live Spots (PSK/WSPR/RBN)
features.notes: Source selector for PSK Reporter, WSPRnet, RBN.

features.name: Callsign Watchlist
features.notes: Reviewed 2026-03-02: WatchlistStore + WatchlistPanel + WebServer debug endpoint present. Alert-on-spot wired.

features.name: Band Conditions (DE-DX VOACAP)
features.notes: Per-band reliability bars.

features.name: ENV Temperature Pane (PLOT_CH_TEMPERATURE)
features.notes: ENVPanel with temperature history graph added 2026-03-02 (WI-4). BME280Provider backend present.

features.name: ENV Pressure Pane (PLOT_CH_PRESSURE)
features.notes: ENVPanel pressure widget added 2026-03-02 (WI-4).

features.name: ENV Humidity Pane (PLOT_CH_HUMIDITY)
features.notes: ENVPanel humidity widget added 2026-03-02 (WI-4).

features.name: ENV Dewpoint Pane (PLOT_CH_DEWPOINT)
features.notes: ENVPanel dewpoint widget added 2026-03-02 (WI-4). Derived from T/H via Magnus formula.

features.name: Screen Blanking / Display Power
features.notes: XSET_DPMS, TVSERVICE (RPi), WLR_RANDR (Wayland), DRM_DPMS (libdrm KMS DPMS property), and CONSOLE (TIOCLINUX VT blanking) methods present. selectedMethod_ override added so user can pin a specific method. FBIOBLANK ioctl fix applied (commit 5d5bd6ce). Schedule-based dimming present in BrightnessManager.

features.name: REST API (WebServer endpoints)
features.notes: All ~42 original endpoints implemented as of commit 5d5bd6ce (2026-03-05). Phase 1: /live, /live/status, /live/touch, /live/wheel, /live/key, /live/mouse, /stream.mjpeg. Phase 2: /get_config.txt, /get_time.txt, /get_de.txt, /get_spacewx.txt, /get_sys.txt, /get_contests.txt, /get_dxpots.txt, /get_dxspots.txt, /get_livespots.txt, /get_livestats.txt, /get_satellites.txt, /get_ontheair.txt, /get_dxpeds.txt, /get_capture, /get_dx.txt. Phase 3: /set_screenlock, /set_mappos, /set_displayOnOff, /set_newde, /set_newdx, /set_cluster, /set_title, /set_time, /set_alarm, /set_once_alarm, /set_stopwatch, /get_satellite.txt, /set_satname, /set_sattle, /get_active_pane.txt, /get_pane.txt, /set_pane, /set_displayTimes, /set_mapcenter, /set_panzoom, /set_rotation, /set_rotator, /screen. Phase 4: /api/propagation/voacap, /api/propagation/muf_rt, POST /api/reload, POST /api/display/power, /debug/*. Runtime validation pending.

features.name: Photosensor Auto-Dim
features.notes: Original supported LTR329 I2C light sensor and RPi A0 ADC for automatic brightness. BrightnessManager has schedule-based dimming and sysfs backlight but no photosensor input.

features.name: WiFi Signal Meter
features.notes: Original used Arduino WiFi.RSSI() — ESP8266/ESP32 only. Not applicable to Linux desktop.

features.name: GPIO (MCP23X17) Control
features.notes: Original used MCP23X17 I2C GPIO expander on RPi for LED blink etc. Linux desktop has no equivalent hardware peripheral.
